title: Shaping Austin's Public Service Budgets
summary:
*   The meeting was a dedicated workshop focused on developing the city's operating budget for the upcoming 1988-89 fiscal year.
*   Budget summaries were presented by critical departments, including Emergency Medical Services (EMS) and the Health Department.
*   Other key areas detailing their financial needs included the Library, Parks and Recreation Department, and Public Events facilities.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
August 18, 1988 - SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - 9:00 A.M Council Chambers, 307 West Second
Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooke called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the
presence of all Council-members. The Mayor stated the purpose of the meeting was to hold a
worksession on the
Operating Budget for FY 1988-89.
The meeting was called to order at 9:00 A.M., recessed at 11:15 P.M.. meeting resumed at
2:00 P.M. and adjourned at 5:30 P.M.
During the meeting hours, Council heard budget summaries from Emergency Medical Service
Department, Health Department, Library, Parks and Recreation Department and Public Events
Facilities.
